title: pm-dispatch(contract-review): triage takes no contract reviews — a hand-off names a review seat or a sibling lane seat
body:

_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x6DWPLkX4BaiYjvPnKJWmgg)_

Fixes #29667

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:分诊不再接契约复审。派发席在本席达档审;429 时交接行点名复审席 `review#N`,未设复审席时点名本车道兄弟席 `domain:<lane>#N`,⛔ 永不点分诊。`check-owed-reviews` 的 TAKE 行给出接手者(交接行所点席,或车道席/复审席),不再指向分诊。信箱 `Request: contract-review` 与回程 `Notify: contract-review` 改为车道 ↔ 复审席或兄弟席。分诊轮次只按车道计欠审 head 数。
- 为什么改:维护者裁决「目前各车道都有fable，应该不需要你契约复审」。
- 风险与回滚:只改规则文本、两个只读报表的读法与它们的自测;无新门禁、标签或巡检行。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`contract-review.md` L21–28、L53;`check-owed-reviews.mjs` 的 `takerOf`;`record-recognisers.mjs` 的 `HANDOFF_TARGET`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers`,预期四个自测全过。
- 需要你做的:无,Tier S,由席位达档复审后落地。

## What changes

1. **`references/contract-review.md` 〈复核归属与资格〉.** Triage's fallback (a)(b)(c) is gone, and so is its use in the landing-head re-review line (L53). The dispatching seat reviews in its own seat at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. On a 429 it keeps the pending-review marker and posts the hand-off line naming a review seat `review#N`, or a sibling seat of the lane `domain:<lane>#N` while none is seated, never triage. An owed head is taken by the lane seat or a review seat. An off-duty lane's owed heads go into its hand-over brief and wait for its next seat or a review seat. The claim lines (L26, L28) name the lane seat or a review seat. When two claims are live on one head, the earliest holds and the later claimant withdraws by reply (L28). This is what `contractReviewClaims` already does, and the seat amended its ruling so the text follows the code (6593367094).
2. **`scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs`.** A TAKE row now names its taker (`takerOf`): the seat a hand-off on this head names; otherwise `the domain:<lane> seat or a review seat`; when the lane seat is gone (c), `a review seat, or the domain:<lane> seat next on duty`. The hand-off column prints the named seat. Still report-only, exit 0.
3. **`scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`.** The hand-off target set changes from {`triage`} to `review#N` or `domain:<lane>#N`, with the number required. A line naming `triage` (or `director`, or a seat with no number) is unreadable, so it hands the review to nobody. `contractReviewHandoff` now reads `handed` with `to` where it read `triage`. In `MAILBOX_KEYS`, `request:contract-review` runs lane → a review seat (or a sibling lane seat while none is seated), and `notify:contract-review` runs from the seat that rendered the record → lane. `contractReviewClaims` code is untouched (seat's ruling); its doc comments now say the earliest live claim holds, and that a legacy `triage#N` claim yields to a later one. The hand-off template is exported as `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HANDOFF_TEMPLATE` and pinned verbatim against contract-review.md L22, the way the claim and hold templates are pinned.
4. **`references/project-forms.md`.** L40 carries both contract-review doorbell legs, lane → review seat or sibling seat and back. L43 carries both triage legs, `Request: triage` and `Notify: release-blocker`. "Unsubscribed only" is dropped from L40 because L47 already says a recipient subscribed to the PR is never rung.
5. **`references/triage-duties.md`** (added to the surface by the seat, comment 6592498626). The owed-review step L10 and the triage self-review rows L11–14 are replaced by two lines. The round record counts owed heads older than one round per lane and names the lane; that is a report, not a review. Delta re-reviews of triage's old records go to the lane seat or a review seat. L3 now says 定级复审 so it does not read as contract review. `lanes/triage.md` is unchanged: its only review mention (L15) already says PASS/FAIL is the lane's.

### Line budget (no ceiling row moved, no re-wrap)

| file | before / after / ceiling |
|:--|:--|
| `contract-review.md` | 60 / 60 / 60 |
| `project-forms.md` | 55 / 55 / 55 |
| `triage-duties.md` | 99 / 96 / 99 |

Every edited line is at most 120 bytes. The exception is the hand-off template L22, a single code span (142 bytes; the template it replaces was 122), which the ratchet treats as unbreakable. `check:pm-skill-ratchet` exits 0.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test`: 355 cases pass (351 before). The hand-off battery's pin went from 13 to 17. New cases:
  - a `domain:ui#2` target reads, lower-cased, and hands the head to it;
  - a line still naming `triage` is unreadable on the thread, never `handed`;
  - the template is spelled verbatim in a code span in contract-review.md;
  - the template sent unedited is unreadable.
  The closed-set case now covers `triage`, `director`, `review` and `domain:ui` with no number.
- `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test`: 68 cases pass in 9 batteries (65 before). The triggers battery's pin went from 8 to 10, and the claims battery's from 5 to 6. Every TAKE case asserts its taker. New cases:
  - a hand-off to a sibling lane seat names it as the taker;
  - a `triage` hand-off line gives no (a) and never a triage taker;
  - a review seat's claim posted before the lane's holds the head, with no tie printed.
  The report case asserts that no printed `take:` names triage.
- `pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers` (record-recognisers, check-owed-reviews, mailbox-open, fleet-roster): exit 0.

## Live board

`node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` on objectstack-ai/objectstack at 2026-11-03T01:04Z found 43 open PRs (28 drafts). 18 owe a review: 3 TAKE, 3 WAIT, 0 HELD, 12 DONE.

- The three TAKE rows read `take: the domain:server seat or a review seat` (#29628, #29637) and `take: the domain:ui seat or a review seat` (#29639).
- No row names triage as a taker. "triage" appears only on DONE rows #29623 and #29651, as the side of an existing `triage#1` claim on a head that already has its record.

## Acceptance notes

- The contract review on cf3a1395 (6593356996) was FAIL on M1: the rule text said the lane wins a tied claim, and the code gives the head to the earliest claim. The seat amended its ruling (6593367094) so the text follows the code. The delta commit 7df996e6 rewrites contract-review.md L28 in place (117 bytes, 60/60) and the comments that said the lane wins. It also carries S1, the pinned template. S2 (a per-lane owed count printed by the report) is left for #29242, on the seat's word.
- `review#N` is not yet a `seatKey` spelling, so a doorbell cannot be addressed `To: review#1` until #29242 lands the review seat. Until then the sibling lane seat is the fallback, as the rule text says.
- `TRIAGE_ROUND_MINUTES` keeps its exported name; only its doc changed.
- The two WIP commits on this branch carry no `Claude-Session:` trailer pair. The branch is `claude/project-thread-*`, so AGENTS.md §3 does not allow a force-push to reword them.

All 40 ran with a 900 s timeout each, in a tree with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` done and `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` built. Exit codes were recorded before any pipe, and all 40 exited 0.
